description: Holds attendance tracker records (defined in the EF Core model), linked to users.
business_purpose: Used to track and report attendance tracker records for the HR & User Management area.
record_granularity: One row represents one attendance tracker.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the attendance tracker.

columns.name: userId
columns.description: Reference to the users linked to this attendance tracker.

columns.name: remarks
columns.description: Free-text remarks for the attendance tracker.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was created.

relationships.description: Each attendance tracker references one users (user).

business_rules: created_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Join to Users through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
AttendanceTracker is defined in the EF Core model but was not found in the connected database, so it may not be deployed there.

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against AttendanceTracker: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT Id) when counting attendance tracker records; joins can duplicate rows.
To resolve names, join on: userId = Users.Id.
Do not select latitude, longitude; they are sensitive or may hold very large content.
Defined in the EF Core model but not found in the connected database; confirm it has been migrated before relying on it.
